study type: Cross-sectional comparative design with retrospective classification of exposure
cohort: The study included 42 women, with 21 having delivered by CS and 21 nulliparous women serving as controls.
finding: The study found non-significant differences in pelvic tilt angles (right and left) and pelvic torsion between post-CS women (measured at 6-12 weeks postpartum) and nulliparous controls.
mod_finding: By 8 weeks postpartum, pelvic tilt and torsion in women who delivered by CS returned to near-normal levels, showing negligible statistical and clinical differences compared to nulliparous controls.
